web.term_and_conditions:

  • We conduct thorough quality checks in our warehouse, including barcode, seal, logo checks, expiration dates to name a few.

web.title: Certified Brands Only
web.term_and_conditions: • We ONLY partner with FSSAI certified Indian health brands and FDA certified international health brands.

web.title: KL Rahul's Tested Programs
web.term_and_conditions:
• We go the extra mile for you by selecting popular supplements and test their
    nutritional claims and for heavy metals on the labels. We do third-party lab tests with an independent world-renowned lab at our cost (fun fact: these tests cost about Rs.15,000).
  • We also test for heavy metals in supplements.
  • After getting the results, we compare them with the label's claims and check if they
    meet the FSSAI/FDA standards.
  • Then, we publish the lab reports on our website/app, so you can see the results.

web.title: Product lab report
web.term_and_conditions: It's all about transparency and ensuring you get the best quality supplements.
